More than words

A downloadable game for Windows

Synopsis

Marian Anderson is an experimental android created by Soul Shell Corporation. She has a sophisticated artificial intelligence that is in the testing phase, however, she was abandoned in the laboratory facilities. 

Your mission is to contact her, persuade her to trust you and escape from the laboratory.

About the game

More than words is a conversational game in which you can Chat with a smart, friendly, and beautiful chatbot powered by GOOGLE GEMMA 3. The chatbot remembers your past conversations. The conversations are local, so they're anonymous.

If you are looking for a game where you can have a casual, friendly, or even romantic conversation, then More than words is for you!

Languages

English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese and Italian

Influences

  • Blade runner 1982
  • Ghost in the shell 1995

More powerful and uncensored model

The default model is Gemma 3 with 4B parameters. Depending on your hardware, you could use a more powerful model. For example, Gemma with 12B parameters:

https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-3-12b-it-qat-q4_0-gguf

If you want to try uncensored models, these models are good candidates:
4B Uncensored

https://huggingface.co/bartowski/soob3123_amoral-gemma3-4B-GGUF

12B Uncensored

https://huggingface.co/bartowski/soob3123_amoral-gemma3-12B-v2-GGUF

1. Donwload your models from huggingface.co to folder ...\MoreThanWords\Nexus\MyAndroid

2. When you start the game, select your model in android settings, category Mind.

System Requirements

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K 3.3GHz Or AMD FX-8320
  • Memory: 16 GB
  • Operating System: Windows 10 or higher versions (64 Bit)
  • Dedicated Graphics Card: Nvidia GeForce GTX 950 2 GB/ AMD Radeon R9 380
  • HDD Space: 8 GB
  • One woman english (or the language you want) speech voice (Add Speech Voices)

Soul Shell1 year ago

First of all, thank you so much to take your time and organize the info. The report helps me a lot. There are so many things to test that it's getting out of hand... thank you so much!

"I like that there were multiple "challenges" to achieve [...] I hope you'll add more interactivity and/or goals..."

Yes, exactly at its core, it's already a system where I declare the script from a CSV without having to program it by hand. It controls actions and inputs phrases into the LLM (MoreThanWords\Nexus\MTW\Database\Levels\Level_script_tasks_1.csv). It's missing some details, but it's coming along nicely. Basically, I use a queue that stores tasks (I'm not using Unreal's native behavior tree...), and the tasks work by applying polymorphism (very elegant in terms of code). The idea is to make it easier to develop the adventure in the future :).

I've confirmed the issues you reported, and I'll fix them. Thank you so much for your help! Amazing!

Soul Shell1 year ago(+1)

Having a customizable option for the character would be great, however Character Creator does not allow it (the software I use to make the 3D model), I think I will have to switch to metahuman at some point. I would love to have the option to modify the android.

"if the Android trusts you it will change accordingly if asked?"

It's possible, it occurs to me

1. A first option is to have a list of requests and if one fits, do it (like the old chatbots worked), it's very fast and easy to implement, but it would often fail.

2. Add BERT (small and fast language model) in intent recognition mode, the implementation is not complex, it is moderately complex to do the fine tuning for the intentions, but it would work very well. In fact MTW already had something like that, but I removed it because it would be an extra cost to LLAMA and the CPU would still have more work, but it is possible.

3. The other would be for LLAMA itself to generate the intention after the text, although in instructor mode I'm not sure if it will let you, something like:

User: I want you to take off your clothes

Marian: Ok I'll take off my clothes [Intention: get naked]
